description: Update project metadata on a project item. Supply complete metadata_xml plus updated_fields, or field_name and value to read-modify-write one XMP/project property through AdobeXMPScript with field readback.

expected_value.description: Optional compare-and-set guard for field_name writes.

field_name.description: Named field to update (for example Column.Intrinsic.LogNote). Used with value; cannot be combined with metadata_xml.

field_namespace.description: XMP namespace URI or alias (premiere, dc, xmp, exif). Default premiere for project packet; required for xmp.

item_id.description: Node ID or name of the project item

metadata_xml.description: Complete Project Metadata XML previously read from get_metadata, with the intended field values applied.

packet.description: Packet for field_name writes. Default project (Premiere-private metadata).

updated_fields.description: Exact Project Metadata field paths changed in metadata_xml (for example, Column.Intrinsic.Description).

value.description: Replacement value for field_name. Maximum 4096 characters.

name: set_metadata

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Set Metadata
